title: Import a wallet with your recovery phrase
description: Step by step XRP Mobile tutorial: import an existing XRP Ledger wallet using its 12 word recovery phrase. Type the words in order or paste them, name the wallet, set a device PIN, and your account comes back with the same address and the same balance. The keys stay on your phone, and the PIN is local to the device.
lede: You already have an XRP wallet somewhere else. Here is how to bring it into XRP Mobile, with the same address and the same balance.

steps.caption: Tap Import wallet
steps.body: From the welcome screen, tap Import wallet instead of creating one.

steps.caption: Choose recovery phrase
steps.body: Pick recovery phrase. That is the 12 words almost every wallet gives you when you first set it up.

steps.caption: One word per box
steps.body: Type your words in order, one per box. There is a paste button if you keep them in a password manager, and the app checks the phrase is valid before it lets you continue.

steps.caption: Name it and set a PIN
steps.body: Give it a name and set a PIN for this device. The PIN is local: it protects the app on this phone, it is not part of your wallet.

shots.alt: Name it and set a PIN

steps.caption: Same wallet, new phone
steps.body: And there it is. Same address, same balance, and the keys never left your hands.
